description: This file defines functions and classes for parsing, rewriting, and wrapping streams with special handling for tagged tool call sections, specifically for Kimi tool calls within a streaming context.

methods.name: stripTaggedToolCallCounter
methods.description: Removes counter suffix from tool call IDs.

methods.name: parseKimiTaggedToolCalls
methods.description: Parses tagged tool call sections from text into structured objects.

methods.name: rewriteKimiTaggedToolCallsInMessage
methods.description: Rewrites message content by replacing tagged tool call sections with parsed objects.

methods.name: wrapKimiTaggedToolCalls
methods.description: Wraps a stream to intercept and process messages for tagged tool calls.

methods.name: createKimiToolCallMarkupWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that processes tool call markup within streams.

methods.name: wrapKimiProviderStream
methods.description: Wraps a provider stream function to include Kimi tool call markup processing.
